_note: Real floor tiles from carrea.pl, collected 2026-11-15 for the floor material configurator. Faces are the shop's flat straight-on product images (largest available, no room scenes). face_is_full_tile=true means the image is (or very likely is) one whole tile face at the right aspect ratio; false means a crop or a face of a different format, see notes. Most scans are seamless, so tile edges are not drawn in the image. finish: 'natural' = manufacturer's 'naturale' matte surface, 'mat' = matte. price_pln_m2 is the shop's current price per m² incl. VAT (null = price on request). Shop wording kept in color_pl / availability_pl.

tiles.name: Medley White Rock 60×60
tiles.notes: Ergon (Emil Group). White terrazzo with large white marble shards on light ground; 28 random face patterns in production. face-1 = 60×60 face (506 px, low-res). face-2/3 = left/right halves of the 1200×600 face of the sibling Medley White Rock 60×120 (same design and scale), added for variation. Scans are seamless, tile edges not visible. Listed as 'produkt na wyczerpaniu' (running out). Old price 169 zł/m², 129 zł/m² is a promo.

tiles.name: Medley White Minimal 60×60
tiles.notes: Ergon (Emil Group). Base tile of the Medley family, almost plain warm white with micro grain; quiet companion to White Rock. Seamless scan, 600 px.

tiles.name: Miscela Nacar 60×60
tiles.notes: Arcana. Light grey-white fine terrazzo with small chips and few larger pale shards. face-1 = flat 600 px face; face-2..4 = three separate tiles cut from the shop's 3×3 layout image (180×180 cm), grout trimmed, 585 px each, so they show real face variation. Not rectified.

tiles.name: Lombarda Bianco 60×120 mat
tiles.notes: Ergon (Emil Group). Light grey ceppo-style terrazzo with mixed pebble sizes. Only image is a 1920×800 crop from the 90×90 face, so it is a crop, not a whole 60×120 tile. Running out.

tiles.name: Flodsten Artic 60×60
tiles.notes: Argenta. Off-white ceppo-style terrazzo, soft grey chips. Only flat image is a 425 px crop (low-res); other shop images are angled studio photos of the tile and were skipped. Very cheap (35 zł/m²), running out.

tiles.name: Genoa Grey 60×60
tiles.notes: Płytomex. Mid grey fine-grain terrazzo / concrete look with dark specks. Face cut from a straight-on studio photo of one whole tile on white (bounding box, 4% inset), 2484 px. Photo has a light hotspot in the centre and slight perspective; flatten the lighting before tiling.

tiles.name: Ground Perla 120×120
tiles.notes: Geotiles. Light pearl-grey cement look, soft clouding. The shop image is the 60×60 face of the same series (file '60x60-ground-perla'), 800 px; scale accordingly (it covers 60 cm, not 120).

tiles.name: Ground Gris 120×120
tiles.notes: Geotiles. Mid grey cement look with darker trowel clouds. 1000 px image named '120x120_90x90', unclear if whole 120 face or 90 crop.

tiles.name: Asphalt Off-White 120×120
tiles.notes: Baldocer. Warm off-white micro-concrete with fine aggregate specks. 808 px square of unclear origin (likely a crop), no edges visible.

tiles.name: Claire Cemento mat 100×100
tiles.notes: Carrea own brand. Mid/dark grey cement with pinholes and clouding; the darker concrete option. 3543 px square face, sharpest scan in the set. Running out.

tiles.name: Unique Infinity Purestone White Naturale 120×120
tiles.notes: Emil Ceramica. Warm white limestone-look with fine fractures. Image is a 120×120 square cut from the 60×120 face (file name says so), 800 px.

tiles.name: Mapierre Noble Blanc Naturale 120×120
tiles.notes: Emil Ceramica. Light beige-white French limestone look with fossil texture. 800 px manufacturer face of the 120×120 (seamless, edges not visible).

tiles.name: Pietre Maxfine Lavica Pearl Naturale 100×100
tiles.notes: Iris Ceramica (Maxfine). Pearl/ivory sandstone-look with soft horizontal veining. 4 different manufacturer faces, 1000 px each. Thin 6 mm slab.

tiles.name: Pietre Maxfine Lavica Grey Naturale 100×100
tiles.notes: Iris Ceramica (Maxfine). Mid grey sandstone-look with horizontal bands. 4 different manufacturer faces, 1000 px each. Thin 6 mm slab.

tiles.name: Boost Icor Bone 120×120 Matte Sensitech
tiles.notes: Atlas Concorde. Ivory/bone limestone look, very calm. 3 different faces, 1280 px. Price on request in the shop.

tiles.name: Blade Grafito mate 100×100
tiles.notes: Alaplana. Dark graphite slate/marble look with thin white veins; the dark option. 700 px face.

tiles.name: Mimesis Ecru 20×120
tiles.notes: Emil Ceramica. Light-natural oak plank, warm. One whole plank, 1315×219 px (real size 19.7×119.5 cm).

tiles.name: Log Select Ivory Pure 20×120 Matte Sensitech
tiles.notes: Atlas Concorde. Pale ivory oak plank, Scandinavian look. One whole plank, 2560×427 px. Made to order, price on request.

tiles.name: Manhattan Floor White AS Rect. 60×60
tiles.notes: Shop: domus-sklep.pl (not carrea; page behind Cloudflare, price from search snippets, 182,52 zł per 1.08 m² box). Peronda Manhattan Floor, code 34873, AS = 'All in One' matt slip-resistant finish. Light-grey concrete with fine aggregate. face-1/2 = 60×60 faces cr26/cr03 (estile.pl, eplytki24.pl), face-3/4 = halves of the 60×120 White AS face cr12 (alewnetrze.com.pl), same scale. Scans are over-exposed, gain 0.8 matches the shop room photo. Sources: source/refs/tiles/manhattan-floor-white-60/SOURCE.md.
